item: R385 item 3: a process-wide builtins.open / io.open replacement has no live reader in the test runner today (measured, nothing converted)
summary: Five in-process sites (native_inflight, core_guard, session_hwm_light, member_error_scrub, reindex_throughput) plus one child-process string. Read pytest 9.1.1 and 9.2.0: the bare open( sites are config (PYTEST_DEBUG), assertion rewrite (first import of a rewritten module), junitxml/helpconfig (session end), capture creation, py.path pyimport; none at a call-phase end. Probe with pass-through spies on builtins.open and io.open, under the repo conftest, plain, with -n 2 --junitxml, --log-file, --capture=sys: zero calls from any module but the test, with a control (a bare open and a write_text in the test body were recorded). The one reader that exists is capfd/capfdbinary (tempfile.TemporaryFile -> io.open at call time); no test uses capfd. No helper added. Not measured: pytest 9.2.0 run, plugins beyond xdist.
